purpose: Hash-pinned access record for every witness the full Quanshu pack cites. The Wikisource wikitext files ARE the text the rules quote; the Nanyangtang files are the facsimile witness that collation is still owed to.
not_the_daozang_homonym: A different three-juan work titled 紫微斗數 survives in the Zhengtong Daozang with different star names and a different construction method. No file here is from it and no rule in this pack may ever be filled from it.

retrieval.method: HTTPS GET of MediaWiki action=raw for the Wikisource pages, and of the Internet Archive download endpoints for the facsimile derivatives
retrieval.reproduce: Re-fetch each raw_url and compare sha256. Wikisource pages are mutable, so each artifact also records the revision id it was taken at; a hash mismatch means the page changed, not that the record is wrong.

rights_note.underlying_work: The Ming/Qing Ziwei Doushu Quanshu is public domain.
rights_note.wikisource_transcription: CC BY-SA 4.0 under Wikimedia site terms. Quotation with passage addresses is within those terms; the pack quotes and cites rather than redistributing the transcription as product content.
rights_note.facsimile_images: The Internet Archive item is user-uploaded with no rights statement of its own. Only derivative metadata and the failed OCR layer are stored here; no page image is redistributed.

collation_state.self_collation_done: The five bureau grids, the five bureau verses, the brightness grid and the nayin song were machine-collated against each other and against a closed-form rule derived from them.

printed_defects_located.why_the_printed_reading_fails: 初九 already appears in the Chen cell, and 初五 appears nowhere; the grid must partition the thirty days exactly once.
The grid totals 29 days instead of 30; the missing day is 三十 and the closed form places it at Hai.

printed_defects_located.where: 六十花甲子纳音歌, sixth couplet
printed_defects_located.why_the_printed_reading_fails: 戊 is a stem and can never be a branch.

printed_defects_located.where: 六十花甲子纳音歌, eighteenth couplet

collation_state.facsimile_collation_outstanding: None of the above has been checked against the Nanyangtang page images. That check is the single outstanding acquisition for this track.

facsimile_spot_collation.what_the_leaf_shows: A two-page opening carrying the 太陰 entry of the life-palace chapter: the tail of its palace couplets, then 太陰入男命吉凶訣, 太陰入女命吉凶訣 and 太陰入限吉凶訣 in full.
facsimile_spot_collation.legibility: Fully legible woodblock at this width. Column rules, verse headers (歌/曰/又) and individual characters all read cleanly, including a later hand's faint annotations in the margins. This is the same route that keyed Lilly's 1647 tables after both OCR layers garbled them, and it works here.
facsimile_spot_collation.navigational_finding: Leaf n100 sits inside the life-palace delineation chapter, so the construction chapter - the bureau grids, the Zi Wei day tables, the Tian Fu diagram and the brightness table - lies at a LOWER leaf number in this seven-juan arrangement. That narrows the search for the next pass to roughly leaves 1-100 of 266.

candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.passage: 太陰 palace couplets, Wu/Wei/Shen line
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.facsimile_reads: 午宮陷未申宮利益，丁庚甲生人財官格
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.wikisource_reads: 午宫陷未申宫利益，丁庚甲入生人财官格
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.assessment: The transcription carries a spurious 入 that the print does not. A clear transcription error, and the kind this pack's grade-D delineation cells exist to expose.

candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.passage: 太陰入男命吉凶訣, second verse, closing line
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.assessment: 紳 against 綱. Both make sense; a real textual variant rather than an obvious slip.

candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.passage: 太陰入男命吉凶訣, fourth verse, opening line
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.assessment: Two differences in one line, and the more interesting one runs the other way: the verse belongs to the Tai Yin chapter, so the FACSIMILE's 太陽 looks like the error and the transcription's 太陰 like the correct reading. Recorded as an open variant, not as a correction in either direction.

candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.passage: 太陰入女命吉凶訣, second verse
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.assessment: Same three characters in a different order. Refused content in either reading.

candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.passage: 太陰入限吉凶訣, second verse, opening line
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.facsimile_reads: 二限偏宜見太陰，添進財產福非輕
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.wikisource_reads: 二限偏宜见太阴，添屋进财福非轻
candidate_variants_against_the_wikisourc.assessment: 添進財產 against 添屋進財. A real variant.

facsimile_spot_collation.what_this_establishes: One leaf, five candidate variants. The Wikisource transcription is close to this Ming printing but is demonstrably not identical to it, which is exactly why the construction tables must be collated rather than trusted - and exactly why the two defective bureau cells found by self-collation are worth re-reading from the print rather than silently patched.
facsimile_spot_collation.caveat: These readings are taken from a single 1400-pixel-wide render of a two-page opening. They are candidates for collation, not settled readings, and each should be re-checked at full JP2 resolution before any of them changes an encoded cell.
